description: This file defines the ProductPurchased model class in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for retrieving product purchase data and total counts based on certain filters, by executing SQL queries on the database.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: A model class that retrieves product purchase statistics and totals.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with their quantities and total sales, with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Returns the total number of distinct products purchased, with optional filtering.
